title: Cross-linking, Immunoprecipitation and Proteomic Analysis in Cultured Cells
author: Hao Wang
license_note: PMC full-text XML — Bio-protocol — CC-BY confirmed in article XML

steps.title: Transfect and select stable HEK293 cells
steps.instruction: Transfect HEK293 cells with pcDNA 3.1/V5‑His plasmids (corin WT or N1022Q) using Fugene reagent, then culture in DMEM + 10 % FBS + 400 µg ml⁻¹ G418 at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ to select stable corin‑expressing clones.

steps.title: Seed cells for cross‑linking
steps.instruction: Seed each stable cell line in a 150 mm dish with 25 ml DMEM + 10 % FBS containing ~5 × 10⁶ cells; incubate at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ until ~90 % confluency (≈36 h).

steps.title: Wash cells and add DSP cross‑linker
steps.instruction: Remove medium by suction, wash once with 10 ml ice‑cold PBS, then add 10 ml DSP solution (0.8 mg ml⁻¹ in PBS) per dish and incubate 30 min on ice (4 °C).

steps.title: Quench cross‑linking reaction
steps.instruction: Add 1 ml PBS containing 0.2 M glycine (kept at 4 °C) to each dish, incubate 15 min at 4 °C; do not remove the DSP solution.

steps.title: Harvest and pellet cells
steps.instruction: Discard the reaction solution, wash cells gently with 10 ml pre‑chilled PBS, scrape cells into 1.5 ml PBS with a cell lifter, transfer to a 1.5 ml tube, spin at 900 × g, 4 °C for 5 min and discard supernatant.

steps.title: Lyse cells in NP‑40 buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 750 µl cell‑lysis buffer (50 mM Tris‑base pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 1 % NP‑40, 1 % protease‑inhibitor cocktail), incubate 30 min at 4 °C with gentle tapping every 5 min; centrifuge 16 200 × g, 4 °C for 10 min and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Measure protein concentration and normalize
steps.instruction: Take 1 µl of lysate for protein assay with dye reagent, then adjust lysate to contain 2 000 µg total protein in a final volume of 1 ml using additional lysis buffer.

steps.title: Immunoprecipitate V5‑tagged corin
steps.instruction: Add anti‑V5 antibody (1 : 1000 dilution) and 50 µl protein A‑Sepharose beads to the 1 ml lysate, incubate 2 h at 4 °C on a benchtop rocker with gentle shaking.

steps.title: Wash immunoprecipitation beads
steps.instruction: Spin beads at 16 200 × g, 4 °C for 1 min, discard supernatant; wash twice with 1 ml pre‑chilled PBS for 5 min each, then centrifuge 16 200 × g, 4 °C for 1 min to remove PBS.

steps.title: Elute proteins with reducing sample buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl 2× SDS‑PAGE sample buffer containing 5 % β‑mercaptoethanol, incubate 30 min at 37 °C; spin 16 200 × g, 4 °C for 1 min and collect the supernatant (eluted proteins).

steps.title: Separate proteins by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Load the entire 50 µl eluate plus 5 µl pre‑stained protein ladder onto a 4‑20 % Tris‑Glycine gradient gel and run at ≤160 V in SDS‑PAGE buffer until the dye front approaches the bottom of the gel.

steps.title: Silver‑stain gel
steps.instruction: Stain the gel using a commercial silver‑staining kit (Thermo Fisher) according to the manufacturer’s instructions.

steps.title: Slice gel and prepare pieces
steps.instruction: Cut the stained gel horizontally into 11 slices with a surgical blade, transfer each slice to a microcentrifuge tube, and cut the slices into ~1 mm³ pieces.

steps.title: Destain and dehydrate gel pieces
steps.instruction: Wash pieces with 200 µl deionized water, destain using the SilverQuest kit per protocol, then wash away destain solution with five washes of 175 µl deionized water; add 175 µl acetonitrile for 5 min, remove and dry in a SpeedVac for 3 min.

steps.title: Reduce disulfides with DTT
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl DTT solution (5 mg ml⁻¹ in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate) to the gel pieces, incubate 30 min at room temperature, then remove the solution.

steps.title: Alkylate cysteines with iodoacetamide
steps.instruction: Add 50 µl iodoacetamide (25 mg ml⁻¹ in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate), incubate 30 min at room temperature, then remove the solution.

steps.title: Digest proteins with trypsin overnight
steps.instruction: Add 15 µl trypsin (10 ng µl⁻¹ in 50 mM ammonium bicarbonate) to each tube, incubate at room temperature overnight to complete digestion.

steps.title: Extract peptides from gel pieces
steps.instruction: Add 30 µl extraction buffer (50 % acetonitrile/5 % formic acid), mix and incubate 10 min; transfer supernatant, then add a second 40 µl of extraction buffer, mix and combine supernatants.

steps.title: Concentrate and resuspend peptides for LC‑MS
steps.instruction: Reduce the combined extract volume to <10 µl in a SpeedVac, then add 1 % acetic acid to a final volume of ~30 µl for LC‑MS analysis.

steps.title: Load peptides onto LC‑MS system
steps.instruction: Inject 5 µl of the peptide solution onto the LC‑MS; load onto the trapping column for 5 min at 10 µl min⁻¹ flow.

steps.title: Perform LC gradient elution
steps.instruction: Elute peptides at 0.3 µl min⁻¹ using a binary gradient: 95 % A (0.1 % formic acid) / 5 % B (acetonitrile/0.1 % formic acid) for 5 min, then linear increase from 2 % to 40 % B over 85 min, ramp to 80 % B for 5 min, and re‑equilibrate at 2 % B for 15 min.

steps.title: Acquire MS data with specified parameters
steps.instruction: Set source spray voltage to 2.0 kV and capillary temperature to 220 °C; acquire full MS1 scans at 60 000 resolution (Orbitrap), select peptides by a Top15 DDA method with dynamic exclusion (3 repeats in 50 s, 90 s exclusion), acquire MS/MS in the ion trap (isolation width 3.0 Da, collision energy 35 %).

steps.title: Process data with Mascot/Sequest and Scaffold
steps.instruction: Convert RAW files to .mgf using Proteome Discoverer 1.4, search against the human UniProtKB database with Mascot and Sequest (mass tolerance 10 ppm, MS/MS tolerance 0.6 Da, trypsin specificity, up to 2 missed cleavages, variable oxidation of Met, fixed carbamidomethylation of Cys). Perform additional Sequest searches for bait‑protein PTMs, validate results in Scaffold (also using X!Tandem), apply FDR filtering (peptide ≤ 0.1 %, protein ≤ 1 %) and retain proteins identified by ≥2 peptides, one of which is unique.

steps.title: Prepare buffers and stock solutions
steps.instruction: Make DSP stock (13 mM DSP in DMSO) and store ≤1 week at 4 °C; prepare cell‑lysis buffer (50 mM Tris‑base pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 1 % NP‑40, 1 % protease‑inhibitor cocktail); prepare SDS‑PAGE buffer (25 mM Tris‑base, 250 mM glycine, 3.5 mM SDS).
